text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm?! There seems to be an illicit
trade
happening in the corner of the
hallway!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You two suspicious people over there!
What are
you hiding?! Show me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-w-we aren't suspicious! It's just a
perfectly
ordinary book...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hiding things is a sign of a guilty
conscience!
Show me what you have
there!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oooh! She saw it! She saw it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's with the that reaction? It's just
some
romance manga, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: T-that's right!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is... it's just me one-sidedly pushing
my likes
onto her. Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You aren't interested in romance manga,
are you
Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Who? Me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let me take a look... "the serious class

representative and the delinquent are
drawn
together despite being polar
opposites." Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic! Having the class
representative as the
main character...
It's definitely a stroke of genius!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
R-really? Well, it certainly is a
masterpiece...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This manga's protagonist is a weakling who falls in love and gets stronger... It makes for such great plot progression!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There are some risque moments as the
story
progresses too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho! Getting stronger... risky
developments...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I've made up my mind! I'm going
to fall in
love as well!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Falling in love will make my Bakushin
stronger! I'll
come out on top no matter
how risky the
development.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And that's the story! To think there was
such a
method out there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I've never been in love! How on
earth do you
find it?!
choice_data_list_en: And that's where love comes in, huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I've never been in love! How on
earth do you
find it?!
choice_data_list: 大切な人を見つけるとか？
ごめん、俺もよくわからない
ごめん、私もよくわからない
choice_data_list_en: Sorry, I don't really get it either.
Sorry, I don't really know either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm! What do you do once you find
someone?
choice_data_list: 大切な人を見つけるとか？
ごめん、俺もよくわからない
ごめん、私もよくわからない
choice_data_list_en: Sorry, I don't really get it either.
Sorry, I don't really know either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So it's about confessing my everyday
affections?
That would definitely feel
good!
choice_data_list: 自分の気持ちを伝えてみればいい
choice_data_list_en: You should just tell them how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Confessing your feelings of affection
gives you a
sense of warmth, and as a
result, your power can
be unleashed... I
understand everything now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to confess my feelings
to
everyone right away! Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I like you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I like you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's... well, I also like your
straightforward
way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each Umamusume reacts differently, but
Sakura
Bakushin O's pilgrimage of
confessions leaves
everyone bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I've more or less finished
expressing my
feelings! With this, I
should be even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I forgot about someone really
important!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I like you too! Thank you for
always
supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether you confess your feelings to
someone or
you are the one confessed
to, you can't help but
feel warm and
fuzzy on the inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Sakura Bakushin O's actions
being far
from what one might call
"love," it appears she
gained something
in her own way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't offer her any advice regarding
love, so I
offer her my sincere apologies.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, do not fret! We can just learn
about it
together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, good timing! URARAAA!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey Bakushin O! Everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for love advice! Do you have
anything
for me?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know what they say about
there being
plenty of fish in the sea! But
we're not near an
ocean, so maybe try
the pond in the park?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, good thinking! In that case, I
have to hurry
over to the park!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! I'm angling for love in this here
pond, so
let's get this Bakushin started!
choice_data_list_en: Isn't that the wrong kind of 'koi'—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can really tell love is blooming here!
It's full of
fish, just like Urara said. I'm
pumped!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! And I intend to get as many as I
can!
choice_data_list: いや、魚の鯉のことかと
choice_data_list_en: No, I thought you meant carp, like the fish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think some wires got crossed along the
way,
but... It's easier to accept my fate
and fish with
her till she's satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can certainly feel it now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of not knowing whether
there'll be a
nibble or not... This
heart-pounding excitement
must be
love!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Those who master fishing also master
love! That's
definitely what that saying is
all about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Come here, lil' fishies! I'll show
you what I
can do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us stick around and catch
plenty of
fish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we head back, Sakura Bakushin O

triumphantly proclaims that she can feel
how
much her strength has grown.
